name: Adventurer's Guild, North
desc1: This corridor is lit by lamps lining the walls, and appears to be well
desc2: used. An arrow painted on the wall has the words 'Offices' and
desc3: 'Guildmaster' written in a bold script underneath it. The corridor
desc4: continues to the east. A wide wooden stairway leads up to the second
desc5: floor, where the Guildmaster waits to give instruction.
